- Subprocessor disclosure cadence (Helix wants upfront list vs. our current 30-day notice).
- Data categories ambiguity (they included training data in the questionnaire; need confirmation whether customer content includes model training).
- SCCs customization: minor edits around liability and audit windows.

Action needed from ops/sales: Monica, can you confirm the active subprocessors for the Helix pilot and whether any of them are in-scope for EU-hosted services? Ben, flag commercial implications if we accept upfront subprocessor list request.

Proposed next step: can Laura or someone on legal confirm whether Redwood can shorten the notice window to 14 days subject to a standard commercial concession? If not, we will take the redlines as-is but will likely request that concession.
